items.title: Oil prices jump more than 6% after Trump says U.S. will hit Iran hard
items.description: Oil rose sharply amid renewed tensions in the Middle East after Iran launched an attack on U.S. forces using ballistic missiles.

items.title: JPMorgan, Schwab and UBS manage millions in Trump's $858 investment portfolio
items.description: JPMorgan, Schwab, UBS and Stephens Inc. are among the firms that have managed Trump's fortune in accounts worth at least $858 million, a CNBC analysis found.

items.title: Humana tops quarterly estimates, maintains profit outlook as medical costs stay in line
items.description: Humana maintained its 2026 adjusted profit outlook of at least $9 per share, which some analysts called a "disappointment" amid high expectations for insurers.

items.title: Why shareholders are suing Novo Nordisk over next-generation weight-loss drug
items.description: Investors claim Novo Nordisk misled the market about CagriSema's tolerability, after disappointing clinical trial results wiped billions off its market cap.

items.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Wednesday
items.description: Ford had a great earnings night. Plus, earnings updates from memory giants SK Hynix and Seagate.

items.title: We're exiting our position in a household products giant after a soft quarter
items.description: Shares are down about 3% in premarket trading.

items.title: Tim Cook’s last earnings call comes at momentous time for Apple with stock at record
items.description: Apple just hit a $5 trillion market cap for the first time, but CEO Tim Cook still has plenty of concerns to address on his final earnings call at the helm.

items.title: YES Network, MSG Networks to exit Gotham app for DAZN streaming service
items.description: The regional sports networks that air games for local New York and New Jersey teams, including MLB's Yankees and NHL's Rangers, will have a new streaming home.

items.title: Nike was once China's sneaker king. Here's why its sales have fallen 30%
items.description: China was once Nike's fastest-growing region but the company has lost relevance among young consumers and ceded market share to smaller, domestic brands.

items.title: Procter & Gamble revenue misses estimates as volume stays unchanged
items.description: Procter & Gamble reported quarterly earnings per share that topped Wall Street's estimates, but its revenue fell short of expectations.

items.title: Chip stocks shed more than $1 trillion as selloff hits companies powering AI boom
items.description: Nvidia, SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics have led the selloff since market close on Friday.

items.title: Cyclospora outbreak tied to Taco Bell will steal the spotlight from Yum Brands' earnings
items.description: Wall Street is projecting a strong second quarter for Yum Brands, but investors' focus will be on updates related to the cyclospora outbreak tied to Taco Bell.

items.title: Ukraine has found a new pressure point in Russia’s wartime economy
items.description: Ukraine's drone attacks on Russia's biggest online retailer Wildberries have ratcheted up the pressure on Moscow's wartime economy.

items.title: Warren probes Pentagon program to hire highly paid private sector workers
items.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren, D-Mass., said she is concerned about a Pentagon program to pay high salaries to Wall Street recruits.

items.title: UBS CEO says the AI pullback is healthy — but there’s a bigger risk investors should watch
items.description: The Swiss banking gian reported pre-tax profits of $3.6 billion for the quarter, as CEO Sergio Ermotti warned of geopolitical volatility ahead.

items.title: SK Hynix shares tank as exponential earnings growth fails to satisfy AI-charged expectations
items.description: SK Hynix shares fell as exponential profit and revenue growth failed to meet analysts' lofty expectations for a darling of the artificial intelligence sector.

items.title: Why America's super rich have embraced the appeal of British soccer teams
items.description: American investors now control more than half the Premier League. CNBC examines why U.K. soccer clubs have become attractive long-term assets.

items.title: Elon Musk's xAI sues Minnesota over law to ban 'nudify' apps
items.description: Elon Musk's xAI, now owned by SpaceX, is challenging a law that would ban so-called nudify apps in Minnesota

items.title: Audi continues U.S. product push with three-row Q9 SUV
items.description: Audi sales have struggled in the U.S. over the last several quarters. The brand has been hit by tariffs and a market shift away from EVs. New product may help.

items.title: Trump, DOJ ask Supreme Court to toss $83.3M defamation award to E. Jean Carroll
items.description: The Supreme Court recently rejected President Donald Trump's bid to hear his appeal of another $5 million verdict in favor of Carroll.
